facts.fact: The Maliweb review of the Transition's land reforms says a unique cadastral number (NINACAD) has been given to over 1.5 million parcels in Bamako's six communes, Kati cercle and several towns, and the digitised documents module MoDoNum was updated at the land conservatories of Bamako and Kati.
